challenge: You want to outsource your logistics to a distributor.
solution: Tekpoint takes care of your complete warehousing.
benefits: Save storage costs and time to focus on your main business.

challenge: You spend a lot of time taking back and reselling used devices and resources, or you cannot find ideal options for recycling.
solution: Tekpoint will buy your used devices and either recycle, or price and resell them.
benefits: Easily regain tied capital from used devices.

challenge: Tekpoint takes over your bundling, repacking, labeling and barcode generation activities.
solution: Increase your sales and marketing efficiency by bundling different product categories, for example smartphones and IOT.
benefits: Increase your sales through bundle-promotions, such as a mobile phone combined with a gadget.

challenge: You want to repack certain products because of legal or customer requirements?
solution: Tekpoint will take care for all opening, refilling, redesigning and resealing activities.
benefits: Add value to your devices and adapt your products to special needs of your customers.

challenge: You want to offer a broader product portfolio without the hassle and risks of warehousing and owning the stock?
solution: Tekpoint will integrate with your platform and seamlessly deliver to your customers directly from our warehouses.
benefits: Reduce overhead costs in logistics and warehousing while offering the latest products on the market.

challenge: You are missing local contacts and have little expertise in European markets, and therefore there is a lack of price control.
solution: As a national distributor, Tekpoint offers long-term contacts and develops the ideal placement strategy for your brand.
benefits: You benefit from just one distributor for all Central and Eastern Europe who provides comprehensive support – from sell-in to sell-out.

challenge: You require local product and brand experts who can develop individual, market-specific content. You neither have market-related empirical values in reporting and scaling nor opportunities for discounts or contacts to multipliers.
solution: Market experts from our large, professional network and our internal creative team develop content that is relevant to the market and your brand's target groups.
benefits: Use sales-promoting measures to your advantage and handle all of your sales and marketing activities through just one contact person.

challenge: You find it difficult to choose the right partner and to carry out a target group analysis. As a middleman between sales and marketing, you are always involved and dependent on various agencies.
solution: With our in-house network, we develop campaigns tailored to your brand and put together a suitable partner portfolio for your product and corporate PR.
benefits: Benefit from obtaining comprehensive advice from just one contact person at any time – from briefing to implementation.

challenge: Without cooperating with a professional distributor, you will lack scalability and billing options, as well as cost controls.
solution: We support you comprehensively – from dispatch to return. You use our financing and billing service as well as the advantage of guaranteed bookable slots.
benefits: Save costs when activating campaigns with optimized effect. A holistic handling of sell-in, returns, repair and remarketing.

challenge: As a foreign brand, you are not part of a network of well-known advertisers in Europe. You lack cost and placement optimizations with high initial CPM prices.
solution: Tekpoint maintains long-term partnerships with the largest providers in the field of outdoor marketing. Existing contracts allow a preferred price batching.
benefits: With Tekpoint as a partner, your product placement and due diligence are already in place. We receive lower prices for higher reach and longer campaign times.

challenge: Your branding and corporate design does not exist or has to be adapted to the European market.
solution: Our professional design team knows the specific requirements of tech and IT service providers well. They develop a targeted branding and corporate design for you.
benefits: Thanks to our experience in tech, we already know your business model, requirements and target group. Save time with less coordination and only one contact person.

challenge: You would like to publicly communicate the market entry of a new brand or product but you lack the right contacts to service providers and the press.
solution: As a widely connected distributor, we not only have internal marketing resources, but also an established network of agencies and experience with launch events and PR coordination.
benefits: We share our market knowledge with you, connect you with local contacts and carry out the planning and coordination of the event on site for you.

challenge: Manual ordering, handling and invoicing is inefficient for high-quantity goods processing.
solution: Full stack EDI processes with fast onboarding: ORDERS, ORDRSP, DESADV, INVOIC message types for automated order processing, confirmation, delivery notification, and invoicing.
benefits: Automated standard business processes, reduced process costs, integration with ERP systems, standardised processes in supply and logistics chains.
